reviews.text: Very grateful, excellent service, they feel like family, 600 Seat
I loved the service and professionalism; they are undoubtedly the best.

I couldn't be more hurt by Quique. I took my dog ​​to the clinic because she had chewed on the Seresto flea collar and vomited a little that morning. At 5 pm, I went to the clinic for an examination. He took an x-ray and blood work and gave her a vitamin injection and medication for the vomiting. He told me to buy activated charcoal in case she had been poisoned by the Seresto flea collar. He reviewed the x-ray, which showed only a slight stomach inflammation, and the blood work, which he said wasn't alarming. We left, and right there outside the door, my dog ​​had massive bloody diarrhea in the street. I went back, and he prescribed antibiotics, but at no point did he suggest stabilizing her at his clinic, and he didn't seem concerned about my dog's bleeding. I got home, and the dog was still bleeding, so my husband went to a pharmacy to get the activated charcoal. I texted Quique, telling him the dog was worse, and then I called him because the dog seemed unresponsive. I gave her the charcoal, but she's still in terrible shape and even having seizures. And Quique tells me it's normal, that it's because of the pain, and to wait for everything he'd given her to take effect. I imagine the worst and take her to the hospital. The dog arrives critically ill; she's having an Addisonian crisis. She's admitted to the ICU, and they treat the crisis in a thousand different ways, but without any positive results. Ava was only four and a half years old and weighed 3 kg. He couldn't have been more alarmed by her condition when we were at his clinic. I keep berating myself for having listened to him, thinking that maybe if I had gone to the hospital a little earlier, she wouldn't have arrived in such bad shape. Anyway, he's disappointed me as a veterinarian. Maybe it was difficult for him to know she was having an Addisonian crisis, maybe he confused her with the Seresto, but when he saw my dog ​​bleeding, how could he not say, "Run, to the hospital!" Because there's no veterinary emergency there, as his business card claims. I was paralyzed and trusted him. My mistake.

Thank you to the whole team, I'm very happy with the service and assistance.
Today they operated on my dog ​​Coco, a beautiful 3-year-old pinscher.
They were very kind and friendly. 10/10

Over on holiday in Valencia and could not recommend this practice more, especially for fellow visitors. Very friendly and helpful staff. One of the staff had fantastic English too which was very helpful for us communicating what we needed for our dogs for returning back to Ireland. Thanks so much. 😊 …
Excellent service!!!
The last time we went was to have our dog spayed and everything went very well, the next day she was as if nothing had happened, now she's fully recovered, they treat them with respect and affection.

These are truly exceptional professionals, offering excellent service and accurate diagnoses from the very first moment. You can tell when they're genuinely in it for the love of animals, not just for the money. Thank you, León has a new home, without a doubt.

An exceptional person, a true professional. I took my Caucasian Shepherd with a torn cruciate ligament, they operated on the dog properly and at a very good price. There's always that fear at first, but he's earned the right to take all my animals to him.
A magnificent veterinarian. Excellent service. They are true animal lovers, even selflessly; their dedication is evident. Congratulations on the great work.

I'm absolutely delighted with the service. It's clear the people there love animals and care for them. They treated my dog ​​with so much love. They've become the family's go-to vet. Without a doubt, excellent.

He loves animals, Kike offers flexible payment options, and he's been a huge help to me with all the pets I've brought him. He's always been incredibly helpful and has always been very accommodating. He's a wonderful person, and I'm so grateful for his amazing work.

It's wonderful when a veterinarian like Kike treats our animals so well and even takes the time to reply via WhatsApp when we have a problem. That's why I recommend the clinic, especially since they collaborate with animal shelters to help the most vulnerable.
The guy is very professional and cured my kittens, I am very grateful 😇 …
Quique is my dog ​​Lola's vet. He just operated on her and I can't thank him enough for his care. The post-operative follow-up has been excellent.
They are very professional in their work and treat pets with great care. Thank you.
